intro: Today is about giving the kids a Hong Kong day to remember: the century-old Star Ferry across Victoria Harbour, the Peak Tram up to Victoria Peak, photos with celebrity figures at Madame Tussauds, then a Ding Ding tram across Hong Kong Island. HSR tickets, Peak Tram and Madame Tussauds tickets should all be bought online in advance.

items.title: K Hotel → Guangzhou South Station (广州南站)
Enter station, security check
items.note: Trains to Hong Kong require earlier arrival; 40 min should be allowed.
items.tip: Documents for entering Hong Kong and returning to the mainland must be carried; check once more before leaving.

items.title: HSR: Guangzhou South → Hong Kong West Kowloon (香港西九龙)
items.tip: HSR tickets should be bought as soon as sales open; year-end tickets sell out fast.

items.title: West Kowloon Station border clearance
items.note: Mainland exit and Hong Kong entry are both done inside the station.

route.title: West Kowloon Station → Tsim Sha Tsui
route.desc: Taxi from outside the station, ~15 min.

route.title: Tsim Sha Tsui waterfront and Avenue of Stars (尖沙咀海滨、星光大道)
route.desc: The Central skyline is seen across Victoria Harbour. The Avenue of Stars has a Bruce Lee bronze statue, linking to Bruce Lee's ancestral home visited on the 23rd.

route.title: Star Ferry (天星小轮)
route.walk: Walk to Tsim Sha Tsui pier
route.desc: Century-old ferry; ~10 min across Victoria Harbour.

route.title: Lunch: Central (中环)
route.desc: Eat early to avoid the noon crowds.

food.name: Kau Kee Beef Brisket (九记牛腩)
Tsim Chai Kee Noodle (沾仔记)
food.desc: Wellington Street; fresh shrimp wonton noodles.

food.name: Lan Fong Yuen (兰芳园)
food.desc: Silk-stocking milk tea, pork chop bun.

route.title: Tai Cheong Bakery (泰昌饼家)
route.desc: Flaky-pastry egg tarts, bought and eaten on the go.

route.title: Peak Tram (山顶缆车)
route.walk: ~10 min walk to the Garden Road lower terminus
route.desc: Century-old funicular; the steep tilt of the car on the way up is thrilling and memorable for kids.
route.tip: Queues can be long. A Madame Tussauds + Peak Tram combo ticket gives access to a dedicated lane.

route.title: Madame Tussauds Hong Kong (杜莎夫人蜡像馆)
route.desc: Close-up photos with wax figures of celebrities and athletes; a favourite with kids.

route.title: Victoria Peak (太平山顶)
route.desc: Views over Victoria Harbour and all of Hong Kong Island.

route.title: Peak Tram down
route.walk: Back to the Garden Road terminus

route.title: Ding Ding tram (叮叮车)
route.walk: Walk to Des Voeux Road Central to board
route.desc: Century-old tram. Upper deck front row for street views; ~20 min to Wan Chai.

route.title: Wan Chai cha chaan teng (湾仔冰室)

food.name: Pineapple bun with butter, iced lemon tea (菠萝油、冻柠茶)
